title: Landscape with Red Trees (Maurice de Vlaminck)
moodDescription: Fauvist wild kinetic energy; explosive pure vermilion fields, tempestuous cobalt skies, and raw impasto vitality

regions.label: Turbulent Cobalt Sky
regions.spokenLabel: A restless, dynamic sky rendered in thick impasto strokes of ultramarine, turquoise, and swirling storm-white clouds.
regions.timbreDescription: Dynamic wind-driven brass & open analog synth

regions.label: Blazing Red & Ochre Fields
regions.spokenLabel: Rolling hills of radiant crimson, orange, and cadmium yellow, vibrating with the raw heat of the midday sun.

regions.label: Verdant Impasto Shrubs
regions.spokenLabel: Thick, expressive curls of deep emerald green and sunny yellow paint forming the rugged foreground hedge.
regions.timbreDescription: Heavy acoustic upright bass & deep cello pulse

regions.label: The Red Bare Tree
regions.spokenLabel: A slender scarlet tree thrusting upward into the sky like a stroke of pure emotional flame on the right hillside.

regions.label: Red-Roofed Village on the Hill
regions.spokenLabel: A tiny cluster of terracotta-roofed village cottages resting peacefully against the green horizon line.
regions.timbreDescription: French accordion & lively folk violin arpeggios
